description: Review triage for a pull request. Takes a unified git diff (`git diff HEAD`) and returns: diff-lint findings with the lines that produced them, regression impact areas, a risk score 0–100 with the factors that built it (churn, files touched, sensitive paths, whether any test file changed, lint severities, impacted risk areas), generated test cases, and a PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCK recommendation. Advisory: the score measures properties of the diff, not the correctness of the change — it does not read the code semantically and does not replace a reviewer or a static analyser. See notAnalysed in the response.

context.description: Optional PR title or description for richer analysis

git_diff.description: Unified git diff (output of `git diff HEAD` or copied from GitHub diff view)
